name: Houses of Mr. Whiteman ("the forty-pillared house") and Captain Elliott, and Monte Fort, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A view of the buildings around the 'Franciscan Green', Macau, with Fort Monte on the hill behind. On the right is the gateway to the convent of Santa Clara. In the foreground is the curving stone wall of the Praya Grande, with figures in Tanka boats in the bay.
